reused_from_g4_immutable.loss: cross_entropy with inverse-frequency train-only class weights normalized to mean 1 over classes present in the fold's training rows

the_one_bounded_change.description: Unfreeze ONLY the final MobileNetV3-Small feature stage + classifier head; all earlier feature stages remain frozen.
the_one_bounded_change.assertion: explicit named-parameter assertion verified: ONLY features.12.* + classifier.* have requires_grad=True (no unexpected trainable, none expected-but-frozen).
the_one_bounded_change.batchnorm_convention: All BatchNorm layers kept in eval mode (frozen running stats) each epoch, including the unfrozen final stage's BN; its affine params remain trainable and gradients flow through the fixed-stat normalization. Documented choice, consistent with G3/G4 frozen-BN behavior.

optimization.early_stopping: none (a-priori-frozen schedule; no leaky inner val; outer test never used for tuning/selection/weighting)

forward_path_note: Because the final feature stage is trainable, G4's cached frozen-encoder-embedding trick is invalid; G5 runs a full forward+backward pass over pixels every step. For efficiency, each image's deterministic normalized 384x384 eval tensor is cached once in memory and a random D4 tensor transform (rot90 + optional hflip) is applied per step — pixel-identical to the v2 train pipeline because D4 flips/rotations commute with per-channel normalization. Eval uses the identity view only.
leakage_safeguards: Same 4-fold LOGO; outer held-out group untouched by training/early-stop/selection/LR/weighting/thresholds; no outer-fold inspection influenced later folds; excluded QC rows and the 63-row human-review queue never introduced; 116 held/excluded rows never introduced.

runtime.oom_events: none; batch 16 stable (throughput probe confirmed no OOM)
